title: Push pro
tagline: Just an enhanced idea for push protocol
description: Push chat currently doesnt have support for group chats , creating support for private and public forums which can replace discord completely using DAOs and push chat
how_its_made: During this challenge, i had to go through the challenge of not knowing react native since I was a flutter dev , due to this I had to cut a lot of corners. i got over it by depreciating to push notifications instead of push chat , but given some more time and a proper flutter SDK I think I could have got a much more working flutter app
